Lock
Panel refresh rate while this app is in the foreground. User rules have the highest priority and override smart scheduling and MEMC auto-locking.
Smart scheduling\nFollows global scene voting: game boost, idle downgrade after 3s, touch speed-up
Lock 60Hz\nPower saving; good for chats, reading, music
Lock 90Hz\nBalance between smoothness and power
Lock 120Hz\nSmoothest; higher power draw, for high-refresh gaming/scrolling
Refresh rate mode
MEMC frame insertion (IRIS display chip)
Controls whether MEMC / SR parameters are sent to the chip while this app is in the foreground. Chip mode (ABYP↔PT) is managed automatically; any failure falls back to bypass.
Default (decided by iris_config.json)\nOn if the package is listed in the config, off otherwise
Force on\nEnter MEMC even if this package is not in iris_config.json
Force off\nNever enter MEMC even if the package is configured
MEMC parameters (advanced, optional)
One iris command per line; leave empty to use the parameters from iris_config.json. Format: Type followed by space-separated parameters.

One command per line, e.g.:
258 3 10 0 1
273 3 1 255 2
Leave empty to use iris_config.json parameters
258 MEMC switch — game (6 params): "258 6 10 -1 latency -1 preset fps" (latency 18 normal / 34 low / 50 ultra-low), video (3 params): "258 3 10 0 x"; Param0: 0 off / 10 single / 40 dual
273 super resolution: "273 3 1 preset SR-mode", preset 255 = generic, SR mode 1 = LPSR low power / 2 = HESR efficient
267 SDR2HDR: "267 3 preset strength", preset 1 = video / 48 = Genshin, strength 0–100, default 100
